Read and validate the on-disk inventory cache for a version

Source: R/spi-inventory-cache.R
dot-spi_inv_read_cache.Rd

Returns NULL (so the caller knows to re-crawl) in these situations:

  • File does not exist (silent).

  • File cannot be read (corrupt). A warning is emitted and the file is deleted.

  • File has an unexpected list structure. A warning is emitted and the file is deleted.

  • File has an incompatible schema_version. A warning is emitted and the file is deleted.

  • Timestamp is not a valid POSIXct (e.g. tampered RDS). A warning is emitted and the file is deleted.

  • File is older than 30 days, or the timestamp is in the future (clock skew). Silent expiry – caller will re-crawl.

  • Tree is not a data.table or is missing expected columns. A warning is emitted and the file is deleted.

  • Tree size column is not numeric or integer. A warning is emitted and the file is deleted.

  • Tree path column is not character. A warning is emitted and the file is deleted.

  • Tree type column contains values other than "blob" or "tree". A warning is emitted and the file is deleted.

.spi_inv_read_cache(version)

Arguments

version

Character. Branch name.

Value

A data.table (the cached tree), or NULL.
